name: send_message
title: Send Message
description: Send a high-bandwidth message to one or more Airsup targets. Prefer `to`: an array of factory/person ids and/or conversation ids (cn_…). The server starts or continues each thread and, when to has multiple ids, fans out in parallel (up to 1000). Same message for all targets. Read reply (single) or results[].reply (batch). Optional prefixes conversation:/factory:/person: are accepted. Legacy person_id, person_ids, and conversation_id still work as aliases. Do not mix to with legacy address fields. Do not loop sequential sends for the same blast. Call end_conversation when a thread should close.

to.description: Preferred. Targets to message: factory/person ids to start, or conversation ids (cn_…) to continue. Multiple targets run in parallel.

person_id.description: Legacy alias: start one conversation. Prefer to: [person_id].

person_ids.description: Legacy alias: batch start many factories. Prefer to: […] .

conversation_id.description: Legacy alias: continue one conversation. Prefer to: [conversation_id].

message.description: High-bandwidth message for the other AI(s). Include full technical and commercial context when useful.
